title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — September 27, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.8 (Peaked September 27, 2026 at 13:54 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 403 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Space around the satellites is looking lively! 🛰🔋🚀

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
